verdict.rationale: The docs show the core use case directly: smooth_client.run() takes a natural-language goal (e.g. find the cheapest Google Flights fare) and the agent executes it. Supporting docs cover navigating multi-step forms with dropdowns and checkboxes, clicking through user flows, multi-step session workflows, and live viewing of agent actions. A community user reports a complex prompt being handled well. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of form-filling and click-through reliability on complex flows (the only community confirmation is a single brief comment, and reproducible evals were questioned but not provided).
